CENSUS YEAR: 2011

2011 Population Comparison — Patna, Gaya & Nalanda Districts (Bihar)

Total district population (rural + urban) as recorded in the Census of India 2011 — Primary Census Abstract, published by the Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner, India (censusindia.gov.in).

Population figures (Census 2011)

District District code Total population Males Females
Patna (1st) 230 58,38,465 30,78,512 27,59,953
Gaya (2nd) 236 43,91,418 22,66,566 21,24,852
Nalanda (3rd) 229 28,77,653 14,97,060 13,80,593

Totals are in international grouping with Indian-style digit grouping shown; figures are exact values from the official Primary Census Abstract table.

Visual comparison (total population, 2011)

Patna58,38,465
Gaya43,91,418
Nalanda28,77,653

Patna was the most populous of the three districts in 2011 — about 14.47 lakhs more than Gaya and 29.61 lakhs more than Nalanda. (Bar widths are proportional to Patna's total.)

Exact data source (official government)

  • 1. Census of India — Population Finder (official data portal page)
    Census year 2011. This official tool displays the 2011 basic population figures by state / district used in this comparison.
    https://censusindia.gov.in/census.website/data/population-finder
  • 2. Dataset page — “Basic Population Figures of India/State/District/Sub-District/Village - 2011” (Primary Census Abstract)

    https://censusindia.gov.in/nada/index.php/catalog/42557/download/46183/2011-IndiaStateDist-0000.xlsx
